# TEST ONLY — reviewed 2026-11-05. macOS Terminal command. No secrets in this file.
# On Linux replace `base64 -D` with `base64 -d`. Paste ONLY the next line into Terminal.
# It writes ~/finance-probe/app-identity-probe-standalone.mjs, installs pg@8 locally,
# reads DATABASE_URL silently, and prints ONLY the app_connection_probe column.
mkdir -p ~/finance-probe && cd ~/finance-probe && printf '%s' '' | base64 -D | gunzip > app-identity-probe-standalone.mjs && if [ ! -d node_modules/pg ]; then npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm i pg@8 --silent; fi && printf 'Paste the SAME pooled DATABASE_URL used by the Render service (hidden): ' && read -r -s DATABASE_URL && printf '\n' && export DATABASE_URL && export FINANCE_IDENTITY_PROBE_CONFIRM="I reviewed the SQL" && node app-identity-probe-standalone.mjs
